name: healthhub
description: Strava-class analytics for Google Health Connect data, with no backend

scripts.dev: npm run tokens && concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace worker run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run tokens && npm --workspace web run typecheck && npm --workspace worker run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run tokens && npm --workspace worker run test && npm --workspace web run test
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm --workspace worker run deploy
